definitions.gloss: required information; necessary items (on a form)
definitions.explanation: The items of information that must be filled in or provided, especially on an application form or document.

examples.japanese: {必要事項|ひつようじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To fill in the required information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{必要事項|ひつようじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the required information on the application form.

examples.japanese: {必要事項|ひつようじこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入漏|きにゅうも}れ→記入漏れ：20461_kinyuumore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けられません→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: If any required information is missing, the documents cannot be accepted.

notes:
⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ (necessary) + ⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ (item, matter). A fixed phrase of forms, websites and official instructions.
